        id: core-toolchains
        run: |
          node scripts/core-contract-toolchains.mjs \
            --shard "${{ matrix.shard }}/12" \
            --github-output "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

- name: Restore pinned component-build toolchains when selected tests require them
        if: steps.core-toolchains.outputs.component == 'true'
        uses: actions/cache@v5
        with:
          path: |
            .toolchains/elan
            .toolchains/elan-installer
            .toolchains/lean4-src
            .toolchains/emsdk
            .toolchains/wabt
          key: core-component-toolchain-v2-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('lean-toolchain', 'flake.lock', 'scripts/bootstrap-toolchains.sh') }}
      - name: Install component-build OS prerequisites when selected tests require them
        if: steps.core-toolchains.outputs.component == 'true'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential cmake git jq libgmp-dev libuv1-dev pkg-config python3 ripgrep xz-utils zstd
      - name: Install pinned component-build toolchains when selected tests require them
        if: steps.core-toolchains.outputs.component == 'true'
        run: bash scripts/bootstrap-toolchains.sh

- name: Build the pinned shared runtime when selected tests require it
        if: steps.core-toolchains.outputs.component == 'true'
        run: bash scripts/build-lean-link-spike.sh
